checkpoints.description: [1/4] Make every command in the REPL blocking-encounter allowlist actually run

impact_assessment.why: The guard allows encounter, state-machines and ? through during a decision, but the REPL dispatches none of them, so the advertised escape hatches print Unknown command exactly when the player is blocked
impact_assessment.benefits: A blocked player can inspect the encounter, inspect state machines and open help without guessing; the guard contract stops lying
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (wires existing handlers); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first scripted REPL test under a pending decision, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Stop comms from meaning story and expose every grouped CLI surface in the REPL

impact_assessment.why: The non-interactive CLI's comms group opens AI captains and the quantum inbox, but the REPL's comms alias opened the story campaign; the other eight grouped surfaces (flight, narrative, engineering, fitting, logistics, progress, empire, intel) worked outside the REPL but printed Unknown command inside it
impact_assessment.benefits: One vocabulary works in both front ends; the interactive cockpit can reach the grouped surfaces without leaving the session; the story keeps its own unambiguous aliases
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REPL comms output changes from story to comms; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first REPL test pinning comms vs story and the grouped dispatches, real piped REPL run, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Make void readiness honest and have the captain take the Act IV void dive

impact_assessment.why: At Act IV the story asks the captain to hold the Cygnus horizon and swear the Voidfarer's Oath, but the AI resolves the choice without ever using the Hollow Between; /api/void/dive and /api/void/emerge stay permanently in CONTEXT_ACTIONS. The status also reports dive_ready with zero shields although void_dive refuses for shield shear, so the cockpit advertises a dive that fails
impact_assessment.benefits: The two void endpoints are exercised at the story's own void beat; emergency emergence restores the horizon orbit so Act IV still resolves; readiness now matches the engine gate
impact_assessment.risks: contract: void_status may report dive_ready False with a new shield blocker; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: per-campaign one-shot flags in the captain
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first unit tests for readiness honesty and the dive/emerge policy, Act IV probe evidence on three seeds, campaign completion and 180-step gate unchanged, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Expose the item catalog and let the captain buy and use station supplies

impact_assessment.why: The engine, CLI and REST all support buying and consuming station items, but no item catalog reaches /api/state or /api/catalogs, and the AI captain has never bought or used a consumable; three inventory routes are excused as unreachable with a reason that the API itself contradicts
impact_assessment.benefits: Clients can render a supplies terminal from one code-constant catalog; the captain exercises item purchase and use for real; inventory coverage becomes honest
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot/catalogs gain catalog_items (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: captain buys one repair paste and uses it when hurt in space
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first catalog and policy tests, three-seed 2,000-step probes, 180-step gate, full suite and 5/5 gates
